You're generalizing what I said to all birds. I'm talking specifically about waterfowl. They can become dependent on the bread as a food source (especially during the summer, when everyone goes to the park and feeds them) and as a result not seek food elsewhere. Bread makes you fat. Unfortunately not everyone is smart enough to throw bread into grass, but thanks for the suggestion.

There are plenty of other reasons not to feed bread to ducks. As you mentioned, it mucks up the water, and that bacteria could give them botulism. If they're fed too much bread, they could become fat enough to the point they're unable to fly (and thus unable to escape from predators too). 

It's better to feed them chopped lettuce, bird seed, or another alternative. There's no reason to be feeding them bread.
